name: What should I prepare before contacting a foundation repair coordinator?
description: Prepare property documents, inspection reports, and detailed observations of foundation issues to help the coordinator with the initial assessment.

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting a foundation repair coordinator?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting a foundation repair coordinator like Hometelligent Inc., it is helpful to gather any existing property documents, such as previous inspection reports, original building plans, or records of past repairs. Note any observations you've made, such as the location and size of cracks, changes in door/window function, or noticeable settling. This information provides valuable context and helps expedite the initial assessment, allowing our team to better understand your specific situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare property documents, inspection reports, and detailed observations of foundation issues to help the coordinator with the initial assessment.
